decisions.reason: The modular extensions support the core waste-to-energy plant business and add little cost as a product line, but their absence from the website in 2020–2021 raises some doubt.
The waste oil to energy plant is a flagship in the firm's core direction, so it will likely stay despite not being observed recently.
Plastic-to-fuel remains a strategic focus with growing regulatory tailwinds, but the technology's economics are hard and its web visibility has faded, so the risk of withdrawal is notable.
